results.content: # Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN Select Legacy Bundle Increasing Price in September 2026. Disney will be raising the price of the Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN Select legacy bundle to $27.99 starting in mid-September. ## Legacy Bundle Price Increase. The Legacy Bundle will be increasing from $24.99 to $27.99 beginning on September 17, 2026. This bundle includes Disney+ with no ads, and Hulu and ESPN Select with ads. Disney said on its plan and prices page that if guests opted in before August 20, 2026, they will see the price change in their billing period on or after September 17. The bundle is no longer available to purchase for new customers, and existing customers can no longer switch to that plan. #
